full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique, CJ: This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 17-5-2023 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.17754 of 2023 making the Rule absolute. 

 3. The said FIR was registered as Motijheel Police Station Case No.31 dated 16.-10-2022 corresponding to GR Case No.443 of 2022 under section 406/420/506 of the Penal Code which is pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. 

 7. It is true that the High Court Division is authorized to quash frivolous criminal proceeding filed to harass the accused person. When a frivolous case is filed with an ulterior motive for wreaking personal vengeance, in that case the Court may exercise its discretion under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure but such power should be exercised very sparingly and with circumspection. The inherent power should not be exercised to stifle a legitimate prosecution. The High Court Division should normally refrain from giving a prima-frcie decision in a case where the entire facts are incomplete and when entire material has not been collected. 

 8. But in this case it appears from the first information report that the informant has brought an allegation that the accused respondent did not pay the promised amount to be paid to the informant. There was any initial intention of deception of the informant or not is a subject matter of holding investigation. 

 9. Since the case is still under investigation and in the truest sense no proceeding is pending, we are of the view that the High Court Division committed an error of law in quashing the proceeding. The ingredients of the offence alleged to have been committed under section 406/420/ 506 of the Penal Code by the accused respondent or not it is difficult to ascertain at this stage. 

 Accordingly, the criminal petition for leave to appeal is disposed of. The judgment and order dated 17-5-2023 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.17754 of 2023 is set-aside. The Investigating Officer is directed to hold the investigation in accordance with law.
